abstract: AIM: To investigate the etiology and clinical characteristics of hypothalamic syndrome in Chinese children. METHODS: Thirty-three cases of hypothalamic syndrome were analyzed for etiology, initial symptoms, and clinical characteristics. RESULTS: All of the 33 patients manifested symptoms of hypothalamic dysfunction and disorders of the hypothalamus-hypophysis-target gland axis. Fourteen patients were diagnosed with an intracranial tumor by magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) examination, four patients had postoperative intracranial tumors, one had received radiotherapy for suprasellar germinoma, one was hypothalamic-pituitary dysplasia, one had a history of viral encephalitis, and in 12 patients, the cause was unknown. The most common presenting symptoms were polydipsia/polyuria and eating disorders. CONCLUSION: Intracranial tumor is an important cause of hypothalamic syndrome in children, with germinoma the most common. Polydipsia, polyuria, and eating disorders are typical presenting symptoms. Long-term follow-up is needed for patients presenting with central diabetes insipidus, eating disorders or hypothalamic syndrome of unknown etiology. In addition, periodic pituitary MRI scanning is necessary to find potential intracranial tumors that may arise at any time.
abstract_ja: 目的：中国人小児における視床下部症候群の病因と臨床的特徴を調べること。方法：視床下部症候群33例について、病因、初発症状、臨床的特徴を解析した。結果：33例全例が視床下部機能障害と視床下部-下垂体-標的腺系の障害を示した。14例は磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)検査で頭蓋内腫瘍と診断され、4例は術後の頭蓋内腫瘍があり、1例は鞍上部胚細胞腫(ジャーミノーマ)に対して放射線療法を受けており、1例は視床下部-下垂体形成異常、1例はウイルス性脳炎の既往があった。12例では原因不明であった。最も多い初発症状は多飲・多尿と摂食障害であった。結論：小児の視床下部症候群では頭蓋内腫瘍が重要な原因であり、ジャーミノーマが最も多い。多飲、多尿、摂食障害は典型的な初発症状である。中枢性尿崩症、摂食障害、または原因不明の視床下部症候群を呈する患者には長期フォローアップが必要である。さらに、いつでも発生しうる潜在的な頭蓋内腫瘍を見つけるため、下垂体MRIの定期的な撮像が必要である。
